summary: AI is raising the bar for data and analytics leaders to deliver value fast while meeting rising regulatory expectations. When Aviva’s Snowflake adoption drove a surge in demand, a complex role based access model became a barrier to scale. Join Aviva and Immuta to learn how a shift to attribute based access accelerated data access by up to 90 %, strengthened governance with dynamic masking, and delivered AI ready data securely in under six months.
